courses.summary: 亞特蘭提斯是 bp 公開列出的深水中心；本課著重海底連接距離、維修等待與資料可追溯性。本課依序分析海底路徑液相壓降、長距輸液功、遠海維修等待、接口減薄資料、來源與輸出量測，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Atlantis is a publicly listed bp deepwater hub; the course emphasizes subsea connection length, repair waiting and data traceability. The course analyses liquid pressure loss along subsea routes, long-route pumping work, remote-offshore repair waiting, interface-thickness records, source-to-export measurements, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
